titleEn: K Highest Ranked Items Within a Price Range
title: 价格范围内最高排名的 K 样物品
summary: 从网格起点经非零格移动，在给定价格范围内按距离、价格、行、列依次排名，返回前 k 个物品坐标。
insight: BFS 求每个可达格的最短距离；价格大于一且在范围内的格子收集为候选，最后按四级键排序取前 k。
pitfalls: 值一是可走空地而非商品
排序优先级距离高于价格

solutions.title: 广搜距离与四键排序
solutions.idea: 先完整计算可达距离，再统一排序候选。
steps: BFS 起点，visited 防重复，状态含 row、column、distance
弹出时若 grid value 在 pricing 且 >1，记录 [distance,price,row,column]
候选按四字段升序，取前 min(k,size) 的坐标

code.java: class Solution { public List<List<Integer>> highestRankedKItems(int[][] grid,int[] pricing,int[] start,int k){int rows=grid.length,columns=grid[0].length;boolean[][] seen=new boolean[rows][columns];Queue<int[]> queue=new ArrayDeque<>();queue.offer(new int[]{start[0],start[1],0});seen[start[0]][start[1]]=true;List<int[]> items=new ArrayList<>();int[][] directions={{1,0},{-1,0},{0,1},{0,-1}};while(!queue.isEmpty()){int[] state=queue.poll();int value=grid[state[0]][state[1]];if(value>1&&value>=pricing[0]&&value<=pricing[1])items.add(new int[]{state[2],value,state[0],state[1]});for(int[] direction:directions){int r=state[0]+direction[0],c=state[1]+direction[1];if(r>=0&&r<rows&&c>=0&&c<columns&&!seen[r][c]&&grid[r][c]!=0){seen[r][c]=true;queue.offer(new int[]{r,c,state[2]+1});}}}items.sort((a,b)->{for(int i=0;i<4;i++)if(a[i]!=b[i])return Integer.compare(a[i],b[i]);return 0;});List<List<Integer>> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<Math.min(k,items.size());i++)answer.add(Arrays.asList(items.get(i)[2],items.get(i)[3]));return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun highestRankedKItems(grid:Array<IntArray>,pricing:IntArray,start:IntArray,k:Int):List<List<Int>>{val rows=grid.size;val columns=grid[0].size;val seen=Array(rows){BooleanArray(columns)};val queue=java.util.ArrayDeque<IntArray>();queue.add(intArrayOf(start[0],start[1],0));seen[start[0]][start[1]]=true;val items=mutableListOf<IntArray>();val directions=arrayOf(intArrayOf(1,0),intArrayOf(-1,0),intArrayOf(0,1),intArrayOf(0,-1));while(queue.isNotEmpty()){val state=queue.removeFirst();val value=grid[state[0]][state[1]];if(value>1&&value in pricing[0]..pricing[1])items.add(intArrayOf(state[2],value,state[0],state[1]));for(direction in directions){val r=state[0]+direction[0];val c=state[1]+direction[1];if(r in 0 until rows&&c in 0 until columns&&!seen[r][c]&&grid[r][c]!=0){seen[r][c]=true;queue.add(intArrayOf(r,c,state[2]+1))}}};items.sortWith(Comparator{a,b->var result=0;for(i in 0..3)if(result==0)result=a[i].compareTo(b[i]);result});return items.take(k).map{listOf(it[2],it[3])}} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<vector<int>> highestRankedKItems(vector<vector<int>>& grid,vector<int>& pricing,vector<int>& start,int k){int rows=grid.size(),columns=grid[0].size();vector<vector<bool>> seen(rows,vector<bool>(columns));queue<array<int,3>> pending;pending.push({start[0],start[1],0});seen[start[0]][start[1]]=true;vector<array<int,4>> items;int directions[5]={1,0,-1,0,1};while(!pending.empty()){auto [row,column,distance]=pending.front();pending.pop();int value=grid[row][column];if(value>1&&value>=pricing[0]&&value<=pricing[1])items.push_back({distance,value,row,column});for(int d=0;d<4;++d){int r=row+directions[d],c=column+directions[d+1];if(r>=0&&r<rows&&c>=0&&c<columns&&!seen[r][c]&&grid[r][c]){seen[r][c]=true;pending.push({r,c,distance+1});}}}sort(items.begin(),items.end());vector<vector<int>> answer;for(int i=0;i<min(k,(int)items.size());++i)answer.push_back({items[i][2],items[i][3]});return answer;} };
